statements:
CREATE TABLE `activities` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`lead_id` text,
	`actor` text NOT NULL,
	`action` text NOT NULL,
	`detail` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`lead_id`) REFERENCES `leads`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`actor`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE INDEX `activity_lead` ON `activities` (`lead_id`);

CREATE TABLE `agreements` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`lead_id` text NOT NULL,
	`version` integer NOT NULL,
	`file_id` text NOT NULL,
	`signed_file_id` text,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'Agreement Draft' NOT NULL,
	`snapshot` text NOT NULL,
	`created_by` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`lead_id`) REFERENCES `leads`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`file_id`) REFERENCES `files`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`signed_file_id`) REFERENCES `files`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `agreement_version` ON `agreements` (`lead_id`,`version`);

CREATE TABLE `appointments` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`lead_id` text NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`starts_at` text NOT NULL,
	`notes` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'Scheduled' NOT NULL,
	`created_by` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`lead_id`) REFERENCES `leads`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);

CREATE TABLE `files` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`lead_id` text,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`category` text NOT NULL,
	`mime` text NOT NULL,
	`size` integer NOT NULL,
	`object_key` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'Under Review' NOT NULL,
	`remarks` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`replaces` text,
	`uploaded_by` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`lead_id`) REFERENCES `leads`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`uploaded_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `files_object_key_unique` ON `files` (`object_key`);
CREATE INDEX `files_lead` ON `files` (`lead_id`);

CREATE TABLE `leads` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`mobile` text NOT NULL,
	`email` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`country` text NOT NULL,
	`visa` text NOT NULL,
	`source` text NOT NULL,
	`assigned` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'Prospect' NOT NULL,
	`profile` text DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
	`notes` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`rejection` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`archived` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`created_by` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`assigned`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE INDEX `leads_assigned` ON `leads` (`assigned`);
CREATE INDEX `leads_status` ON `leads` (`status`);

CREATE TABLE `payments` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`lead_id` text NOT NULL,
	`amount` integer NOT NULL,
	`reference` text NOT NULL,
	`method` text NOT NULL,
	`created_by` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`lead_id`) REFERENCES `leads`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `payments_reference_unique` ON `payments` (`reference`);

CREATE TABLE `users` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`identity` text,
	`email` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`role` text NOT NULL,
	`active` integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `users_identity_unique` ON `users` (`identity`);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `users_email_unique` ON `users` (`email`);

CREATE TABLE `verifications` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`lead_id` text NOT NULL,
	`reviewer` text NOT NULL,
	`decision` text NOT NULL,
	`remarks` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`lead_id`) REFERENCES `leads`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`reviewer`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
ALTER TABLE `leads` ADD `lock_version` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE `auth_sessions` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE INDEX `sessions_user` ON `auth_sessions` (`user_id`);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `username` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `password_hash` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `must_change_password` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `users_username_unique` ON `users` (`username`);

CREATE TABLE `tasks` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`notes` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`assigned` text NOT NULL,
	`due_date` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'To do' NOT NULL,
	`created_by` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`assigned`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
);
CREATE INDEX `tasks_assigned` ON `tasks` (`assigned`);
ALTER TABLE `leads` ADD `payment_required` integer;
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `status` text DEFAULT 'Pending verification' NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `receipt_number` text;
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `paid_on` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `payer_name` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `notes` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `proof_file_id` text REFERENCES files(id);
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `verified_by` text REFERENCES users(id);
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `verified_at` text;
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `verification_notes` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `payments` ADD `receipt_snapshot` text DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `payments_receipt_number_unique` ON `payments` (`receipt_number`);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `stored_chunks_part` ON `stored_chunks` (`object_key`,`part`);
INSERT INTO storage_usage (id, used) VALUES (1, 0);
